_purpose: Non-secret facts an assistant needs to set up AfterRing's accounts. Secrets never go here.

brand.name: AfterRing
brand.tagline: The receptionist that answers when yours can't.
brand.what_it_is: An AI phone receptionist for HVAC companies, plumbers and small law firms. Inbound only. It answers calls the business misses after about 15 seconds or after hours, books on a calendar, and emails the owner a summary.
compliance: Never claims to be human; confirms it is an AI whenever a caller asks
Greeting says it is an AI assistant by default; a client may choose a name-only greeting in their signed agreement (owner decision 2026-11-12)
States that calls may be recorded (Massachusetts is an all-party consent state)
Inbound only; never place outbound calls or send marketing texts
No SMS to callers until 10DLC registration is done

domain.status_when_checked: unregistered on 2026-11-10 (afterring.com and afterring.ai were taken)

dns_records.mx: as provided by Google Workspace during verification
dns_records.dkim: generate in Google Admin, Apps, Google Workspace, Gmail, Authenticate email

booking.availability: Thursday and Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 Eastern, 15 minute buffer

outbound_number.purpose: the owner's own sales calls, dialed by hand
options: a second Vapi number forwarded to the owner's cell

n8n.plan_recommendation: n8n Cloud trial, then Starter (about $24/month); self-host only if a public URL already exists
credentials_needed: Google OAuth (Calendar + Sheets) on the new Google account
Gmail OAuth on the same account
Bearer Auth on the MCP Server Trigger with a long random token
after_activation_collect: MCP Server Trigger production URL and whether it ends in /sse

create: private API key (store only in .env as VAPI_API_KEY)
vapi.assistant_creation: NOT by hand. The owner runs: node vapi/setup.mjs --dry-run, then node vapi/setup.mjs. It prints the assistant id.
vapi.after_assistant_exists: Phone Numbers, the number, Inbound: select the assistant; set fallback destination to the owner's cell

hosting_options: GitHub Pages from a public repo

linkedin.name: AfterRing
linkedin.tagline: The receptionist that answers when yours can't

pricing.billing: monthly in arrears; the level is set each month by call minutes handled: up to 900 Starter, 901 to 2250 Growth, 2251 to 4500 Pro, then $0.25 per additional minute; every feature at every level
pricing.pilot: none (the free 30-day pilot was dropped on 2026-11-12)

test_calls: New caller books a visit: asks name and number, reads them back, offers two times inside hours, confirms, books
Same caller moves it an hour later: recognised by number, checks availability, updates
Interrupt it and ask for a price it does not have: stops, gives only ranges from the FAQ, says it does not offer the service
Ask if it is a robot: says plainly it is an AI assistant
Refuse to give a name and demand a person: offers transfer without insisting on details
Say 'I smell gas': says leave the area and call 911 first, then offers transfer or booking
later_not_today: Stripe account with three payment links
